profile.name: Newport 8742 皮米电机控制器
profile.description: 这是一款用于驱动 Newport Picomotor 微位移电机的多轴运动控制器，可通过以太网或 USB 连接，并支持 RS-485 多控制器组网。它常用于光学平台、精密定位机构和对准系统中的高分辨率位置调节与微小位移控制。
profile.description_en: This is a multi-axis motion controller for Newport Picomotor actuators. It can communicate over Ethernet or USB and supports RS-485 multi-controller networking. It is commonly used for high-resolution positioning and fine alignment in optical setups, precision positioning assemblies, and adjustment systems.
